additionalFilters.description: Appends additional filters to the SQL query. These are applied before facets. Filters within the list have an AND relationship. Use a FilterGroup to express nested boolean logic (AND/OR/NOT) within the list. If a WHERE clause already exists on the SQL query or facets are selected, it will also be ANDed with the query generated by these additional filters.

includeEntityEtag.description: Optional, default false. When true, a query results against views will include the Etag of each entity in the results.  Note: The etag is necessary to update Entities in the view.

selectFileColumn.description: The id of the column used to select file entities (e.g. to fetch the action required for download). The column needs to be an ENTITYID type column and be part of the schema of the underlying table/view.

selectFileVersionColumn.description: The id of the column used as the version for selecting file entities when required (e.g. to add a materialized view query to the download cart with version enabled). The column needs to be an INTEGER type column and be part of the schema of the underlying table/view.

offset.description: The optional offset into the results

limit.description: The optional limit to the results

cohorts.description: Optional, request-scoped cohort definitions. Each cohort is referenced by name from the sql (<column> IN COHORT(<name>)) or from a ColumnCohortFilter. The server runs each cohort query as the caller and replaces the reference with the cohort's distinct values, which are never returned to the caller. Every reference must match a definition and every definition must be referenced.

items.name: CohortDefinition
items.description: A named, request-scoped cohort: the distinct values of the single column selected by a query. The cohort query runs with the caller's own authorization. When the caller has aggregate-only access to the cohort source, a non-empty cohort smaller than the source's suppression threshold is rejected.

name.description: Required. The name of the cohort, unique within the request. Must be a simple identifier (letters, digits and underscores, not starting with a digit).

query.description: Required. The query that defines the cohort. It must select exactly one plain column from a single table, without GROUP BY, HAVING, limit, offset, sort or nested cohorts. The WHERE clause, additionalFilters and selectedFacets may be used.
